name: MkulimaLink
description: 🌾 Transform agriculture in East Africa with MkulimaLink, a super-app that integrates marketplace, finance, logistics, and farm management for farmers.

paragraphs: MkulimaLink is your one-stop agriculture super-app designed for East Africa. It provides tools like a marketplace, micro-loans, insurance, delivery tracking, group buying, equipment rental, and AI insights. Built using the MERN stack and MkulimaLink is crafted to help farmers and businesses thrive.
features: Marketplace: Buy and sell agricultural products easily.
Micro-Loans: Access small loans to support farm activities.
Insurance Services: Protect your assets with comprehensive insurance options.
Delivery Tracking: Monitor your deliveries in real-time.
Group Buying: Join forces with other users to get better prices on bulk purchases.
